section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section (Study X) describes the instruments used: Body Appreciation was measured with the 10-item BAS-2; actual–ideal weight discrepancy (women only) was measured using the Photographic Figure Rating Scale (PFRS); self-esteem was measured with a 9-item Chinese-adapted Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (Cronbach's α = .86 in women and .88 in men); and life satisfaction was measured with the 5-item SWLS (Cronbach's α = .84 in women and .85 in men). Men did not complete the PFRS because no male version is available. The section does not report sample size, country, ages, BMI, education levels, survey method, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI.
